description: This file defines classes, functions, and data structures for handling XML-RPC server operations in PHP, including capability negotiation, method dispatching, request parsing, and response serialization.

classes.name: xmlrpc_server
classes.description: Main class handling XML-RPC server functionalities including request parsing, method execution, and response handling.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Processes an incoming XML-RPC request, executing the appropriate method and returning the response.

methods.name: add_to_map
methods.description: Adds a new method handler to the server's dispatch map.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Invokes the specified method with parameters, with signature verification and error handling.
